## Bug Description

The tree canvas has a "lock" toggle (`isLockedScreen` in `frontend/src/hooks/useFamilyTreeSettings.ts`) that's meant to prevent accidental changes to the canvas (drag/select/connect are already gated by it in `FlowPanel.tsx`). However, the per-node **edit** action and the member sheet's edit mode are not gated by this lock:

- `FamilyNode.tsx` only hides its pencil/edit button when `data.isReadOnly` is true (`frontend/src/components/view/tree-view/node/FamilyNode.tsx` line ~331), and `data.isReadOnly` is set from `isCanvasReadOnly = isMobile || !canWrite` (`FlowPanel.tsx` line ~122/395) — it does not factor in `isLockedScreen`.
- The member sheet's edit-mode toggle (`canEdit` prop, `MemberSheet.tsx`) is passed `canEdit={!isMobile && canWrite}` from `FlowPanel.tsx` (line ~820) — also independent of `isLockedScreen`.

So locking the canvas still lets a user open the pencil button on a node, or use the member sheet's edit toggle, and edit a member — which defeats the purpose of "lock this canvas so nothing changes."

## Expected Behavior

While the canvas is locked (`isLockedScreen === true`):
- The per-node edit (pencil) button should not be shown.
- The member sheet opened from the canvas should not offer its edit-mode toggle.

## Suggested approach

- In `FlowPanel.tsx`, fold `isLockedScreen` into the `isReadOnly` passed to node data (line ~395) and into the `canEdit` passed to `MemberSheet` (line ~820), e.g. `canEdit={!isMobile && canWrite && !isLockedScreen}`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Locking the canvas hides the pencil/edit button on tree nodes
- [ ] Locking the canvas disables/hides the edit-mode toggle in the member sheet opened from the canvas
- [ ] Unlocking restores both
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`

## Relevant Files

- `frontend/src/components/view/tree-view/FlowPanel.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/view/tree-view/node/FamilyNode.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberSheet.tsx`
- `frontend/src/hooks/useFamilyTreeSettings.ts`

## Findings / verification

- **`isCanvasReadOnly = isMobile || !canWrite`** is at `FlowPanel.tsx:122`. It is used far beyond edit-gating (`useUndoRedo(!isCanvasReadOnly)` line 126, `onNodesChange`/`onEdgesChange`/`deleteKeyCode` gating, `navigationOnly`/`selectionAvailable` on the control panels, the `MemberControls`/`EmptyTreeState` mount conditions, etc.). So we must **not** fold `isLockedScreen` into `isCanvasReadOnly` itself — that would change unrelated behavior (e.g. hide undo/redo, hide the whole `MemberControls` panel when locked). Introduce a separate derived boolean instead.
- **The pencil button** in `FamilyNode.tsx:331` is gated by `data.isReadOnly`. That `isReadOnly` is populated in `useFlowNodes.ts:89` from the `isReadOnly` argument, which `FlowPanel.tsx:498` passes as `isCanvasReadOnly`. The same `useFlowNodes` `isReadOnly` also nulls `onEdit` and the fast-mode add handlers and drives handle connectability — all edit affordances, all appropriate to lock.
- **Union node** `data.isReadOnly` at `FlowPanel.tsx:395` (deps list at line 447) gates "add child to union" — also an edit action.
- **MemberSheet edit toggle**: `FlowPanel.tsx:820` passes `canEdit={!isMobile && canWrite}`. In `MemberSheet.tsx`, `effectiveCanEdit = canEdit || isNewMember` (line 86) controls the Pencil/Eye toggle (line 278) and edit mode. New-member creation can't start while locked anyway (the `MemberControls` add button is `disabled={isLockedScreen}`, line 190), so there's no conflict with the `|| isNewMember` branch.
- **Other affordances already respect the lock** (no change needed): `nodesDraggable`/`nodesConnectable`/`elementsSelectable` (lines 647/651/656), selection button (`selectionDisabled` line 788), and every edit control in `MemberControls.tsx` (`disabled={isLockedScreen}`) and `FlowPanelControls.tsx`. No double-click-to-edit handler exists.

### 1. `frontend/src/components/view/tree-view/FlowPanel.tsx`
`isLockedScreen` is destructured at lines 129–136, *after* `isCanvasReadOnly` (line 122). Add one derived boolean right after that destructure block (after line 136):

const isEditReadOnly = isCanvasReadOnly || isLockedScreen;

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. The format is based on
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), and this project
adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

Releases are cut from `vX.Y.Z` Git tags; pushing a tag publishes the matching
Docker images to GHCR (see [docs/OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md)).

## [Unreleased]

### Added

- A member's profile picture can now be set from one of their already-linked
  gallery photos (with crop), instead of only by uploading a new file (#776).
- Data-quality report now flags a child born after a parent's death year. A
  posthumous-birth grace window (~1 year) is allowed for fathers and
  parents of unknown gender, but not for mothers (#768).
- Research tasks: open questions and to-dos with open/done state, linked to
  any number of members (or none, for general tree-wide tasks), managed from
  the member sheet or created directly from the quality report. Tree nodes can
  show a toggleable indicator for members with open tasks, the quality report
  lists all open research items, and task changes appear in the activity log.
  Gated behind the new `research_tasks` feature flag (#725).
- Gallery face tags can now be marked as an "unknown person" (no member),
  which creates exactly one open, tree-level research task to identify them
  later. Resolving the tag to a member closes its task and turns the tag into
  a normal member link; deleting the tag removes its still-open task, while a
  completed task is kept as history. Gated behind the `research_tasks`
  feature flag (#736).
